title: Don't waste your money with these.
text: Don't waste your money with these.. They are way too flimsy and super thin material, also very cheap material in my opinion, completely not worth it but they do work for what they are intended for although they just feel so uncomfortable and cheap they dont look like the picture at all! I don't know what else to say ... but this is wayyy too much for the material and product given it is not worth even 10 dlls itself not for the 2 of them even or maybe just that, but they charge almost 20 for these? It's just nuts... you could find these at the flea market maybe and you'd probably not buy them after seeing them. BUYER BEWARE!
